probability_policy.name: SOURCE_CERTIFIED_RAW_MAX_MASS_TRANSPOSITION
probability_policy.action: Swap canonical raw winner probability and independently certified class probability; other components unchanged; raw unchanged on abstention or agreement
probability_policy.derived_tie_rule: Valid certificate class first among equal final maxima; otherwise original source C,N,E first raw-logit maximum
probability_policy.proper_guarantee: Only conditional on a correct certificate against SAME raw readout. No cross-context guarantee; wrongcert can be harmful or invariant and remains a soundness failure.
